surah.personality_title: Umm al-Kitāb (The Mother of the Book) — The Gateway of Devotional Covenant
surah.personality_summary: A concise, rhythmic, liturgical opening that moves symmetrically from the objective majesty of divine praise (Tawḥīd and Mercy) to the intimate second-person commitment of servitude (Iyyāka na'budu), culminating in the desperate human petition for the Straight Path. It sets the orientation and spiritual posture of the seeker before entering the vast expanse of the Qur'an.
surah.opening_ending_dynamic: Opens with universal praise of the Lord of all worlds (Rabb al-'Ālamīn) and closes with the petition to be safeguarded from those who incur anger or wander astray.
surah.overview: Surah Al-Faatiha (The Opening) is the 1st surah in the canonical muṣḥaf sequence, comprising 7 ayat. Classified as Makki.

ayahs.translation_saheeh: In the name of Allah, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: In the name of God, the Lord of Mercy, the Giver of Mercy

ayahs.translation_saheeh: [All] praise is [due] to Allah, Lord of the worlds
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Praise belongs to God, Lord of the Worlds

ayahs.translation_saheeh: The Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: the Lord of Mercy, the Giver of Mercy

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Sovereign of the Day of Recompense
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Master of the Day of Judgement

ayahs.translation_saheeh: It is You we worship and You we ask for help
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: It is You we worship; it is You we ask for help

ayahs.translation_saheeh: Guide us to the straight path
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: Guide us to the straight path

ayahs.arabic_uthmani: صِرَٰطَ ٱلَّذِينَ أَنۡعَمۡتَ عَلَيۡهِمۡ غَيۡرِ ٱلۡمَغۡضُوبِ عَلَيۡهِمۡ وَلَا ٱلضَّآلِّينَ
ayahs.arabic_simple: صِرَاطَ الَّذِينَ أَنْعَمْتَ عَلَيْهِمْ غَيْرِ الْمَغْضُوبِ عَلَيْهِمْ وَلَا الضَّالِّينَ
ayahs.arabic_clean: صراط الذين انعمت عليهم غير المغضوب عليهم ولا الضالين
ayahs.translation_saheeh: The path of those upon whom You have bestowed favor, not of those who have evoked [Your] anger or of those who are astray
ayahs.translation_abdelhaleem: the path of those You have blessed, those who incur no anger and who have not gone astray
